Grown up a little

Options A–D, before and after

Taller proportions, smaller faces set higher, almond eyes with lids and brows, no blush, slim arms with hands, muted earth tones, and a prop that names the feature.

School Website

Terra the pot snail

A snail with a garden on their back, the way your website carries your school wherever families find it. Calm, welcoming and always open.

Signature
Eye-stalks and a terracotta pot that blooms.
Voice
Calm, welcoming, quietly proud.
Post ideas
Website launches, open-house pages, "your school, online".

Next steps

Pick any characters to take further. Round 3 can add a front, side and back turnaround, a wider expression set, social post templates in your brand layout, and layered files ready for Lottie animation.

Vector drafts, drawn in code. Every pose shares one body, so the characters stay on-model.
